name: captain cyan7 liquid-alliance successor
hypothesis: Replacing identity-based protection and alliance loyalty with one observable profit arbiter will improve Captain WC6 v3 same-seat score by at least 15 percent while preserving runtime correctness.
evidence_unit: one hash-bound cyan7:v1 candidate derived from Captain WC6 v3, evaluated at the first outcome-blind local seat that emits an accepted cyan7 alliance marker and then against the frozen current-field hosted roster
claim_boundary: A pass authorizes only cyan7:v1 as a successor candidate for Captain Underpants Maximum Aura. It does not establish global dominance, transfer evidence to Odin, Mickey, Hrafn, or another player, or justify any later source change.

baseline.evidence: Captain WC6 v3 policy version d49a5027-9a42-4d03-a72a-3fa3d86885af, branch origin/rci/captain-wc6-neutral-first-20260725, behavioral source commit 80d54f18ad3071e35b4c0b80377e115c0f701d75, exact linux/amd64 image sha256:2d273db10769d57076b1d72dccac06aff0eb519ffaf574a95ad97b29949dd86a, local causal receipt experiments/evidence-captain-wc6-observable-first-contact-20260725.json
baseline.measurement: WC6 v3 beat its exact v2 control by 51.53 percent at the selected local seat, but its hosted 4-of-4 terminal result is absent, its independent 20-of-20 gate is open, and it was never submitted. The comparison baseline for cyan7 is score ratio 1.0 against exact WC6 v3 at the frozen cyan7 reach seat.

intervention.one_change: Replace all identity-based protection and durable alliance loyalty in the Captain runtime with one liquid-alliance profit arbiter: every rival remains attackable, alliance requests require observable positional value, and any alliance may be broken immediately when leader pressure or favorable conversion has greater observable value.
forbidden_confounds: changing attack percentages, build cadence, boat selection, planner protocol, or model configuration
special-casing any player name, player ID, coalition tag, or prior ally
changing the frozen outcome-blind qualifier seed schedule 20260800 through 20260811 after observing results
relaxing zero unexplained holds, rejections, fallbacks, degradation, or identity checks
submitting or changing the live Captain v1 membership before every promotion gate passes

controls.name: no-identity-protection
controls.purpose: prove that cyan7 gives no player or former ally immunity
controls.expected: with an otherwise best legal conversion against a K1Z-labelled or formerly reciprocal rival, cyan7 selects the conversion and emits no protection redirect

controls.name: profit-only-request
controls.purpose: prove that alliances cannot consume tempo without observable survival or position value
controls.expected: cyan7 rejects alliance requests when reliable growth or conversion is available and requests only a nonhostile materially sized rival while trailing under pressure or collapse

controls.name: liquid-break
controls.purpose: prove that no alliance is permanent
controls.expected: cyan7 selects an offered break immediately when an ally is the leader, blocks a competitive finish, or is a favorable material conversion, regardless of identity or alliance age

controls.name: wc6-parity
controls.purpose: bind unrelated behavior to the exact diagnostic parent
controls.expected: all fixtures without a profitable alliance request, alliance break, or identity-protection conflict remain deeply equal to Captain WC6 v3

primary_metric.name: matched same-seat normalized score ratio versus exact WC6 v3
primary_metric.unit: candidate score divided by control score

terminal_outcomes.promote: All controls and source suites pass; the exact linux/amd64 image reaches an accepted cyan7 marker outcome-blind; the matched seat ratio is at least 1.15 with zero unexplained holds, rejections, fallbacks, or degradation; hosted current-field is 4 wins of 4 with a valid marker; independent regression is 20 wins of 20; Captain identity and policy hashes match.
terminal_outcomes.park: The run and audit are valid but cyan7 misses the 1.15 local floor, loses any hosted episode, misses any regression win, or is dominated by WC6 v3.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: The seed schedule, runner, hosted service, credential, time, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling prevents a complete bound result.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: A source, image, roster, replay, marker, semantic-equivalence, identity, runtime-cleanliness, or control binding fails.

stop_rules: stop before any episode if a control, focused source test, image identity, or request binding fails
stop the local reach schedule at the first accepted cyan7 marker and freeze that seed, seat, turn, request, and replay before inspecting outcome
stop and park on any unexplained hold, rejection, fallback, degradation, invalid marker, or matched score ratio below 1.15
stop and park on the first hosted or regression loss
stop and preserve Captain v1 on any credential, player, policy, membership, or champion mismatch
stop at every declared engineering, wall, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling; never infer failure from an incomplete run

next_actions.promote: Upload cyan7:v1 under the Captain player if not already uploaded, submit with auto-champion always, verify qualification, sole champion identity, and the first completed Competition round, then record and push receipts.
next_actions.park: Keep Captain v1 live, archive cyan7 evidence, and select a different single mechanism from replay diagnosis.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve all complete artifacts, keep Captain v1 live, and resume only the incomplete bound step without changing source or seeds.
next_actions.audit-failed: Keep Captain v1 live and repair only the smallest failed binding or checker before any rerun.

authority.data_scope: user-owned repository plus official Coworld/Softmax APIs, hosted results, and public replays for the ProxyWar game only
authority.external_actions: The user explicitly authorized a new Captain submission. Official cyan7 diagnostic upload, hosted requests, league submission, membership, and champion change are authorized only after the complete preregistered gates pass; paid compute and unrelated accounts remain not authorized.
